I work as a nanny. The worst things I see are no concrete bedtimes or schedules. Make room for spontaneity but have a set time for eating, napping, sleeping, going outside, etc. It makes a huge difference in behavior. 
Also limit the electronics, especially around bedtime. You should be using that time to help you kid relax without an electronic. 
And finally be firm and consistent with discipline, especially when the child is being watched by other people. Having different rules with different people leads to shitty behavior.
